Each line is a functional net description. Refer to sheets 3–8 for terminal/port positions.

TopicConnections as proposed in the uploaded D12
EnableX3/X4 gated +24 to button C and Finder 13.61 L/+ and 11; 0 V to Finder N/−, SK3/4 A2 and EAO LED−.
Momentary inputSB1/2 NO → K1/K2 terminal 3 impulse.
Finder outputK1/K2 NO terminal 14 → SK3/SK4 relay coil A1 and EAO LED+.
ThermocoupleType K + → E1/E2 terminal 6; Type K − → terminal 5.
Omron demandE1/E2 terminals 1 (+), 2 (−) → W1/W2 A1 (+), A2 (−).
SSR and amber pilotGated +24 to SSR input 3+ and HL LED+; SSR 4− and HL LED− to W output 13; W 14 to 0 V.

DC returnHeater− → corresponding external DC PSU−; Finder 14 and SSR −2 are NOT DC−.
Relay coil / socketFinder 62.31 24 V coil uses SK3/SK4 A1/A2, socket family 92.03 suffix TBD; 34/14 contact polarity-sensitive.

Engineering cross-check — open items

Based on the supplied D12 drawing set, the user’s separately recorded physical controller observations and selected manufacturer references. These are discrepancies, missing specifications or release tests, not claims that the circuit has been electrically validated.

Review itemFinding / required validationPriority
XB5AD23 two NO contact terminalsThe selector has two NO contacts per Schneider data. Assign A (controller AC) = 13–14; B (gated 24 V) = 23–24 as PROVISIONAL IEC diagram identifiers only. ZBE203 double NO uses 13/14 and 23/24, while separate ZBE101 blocks can have other stamped pair numbers. Inspect the actual fitted contact-block arrangement and confirm each contact electrically before wiring.HIGH
Confirm E2 model on nameplateSheet 1 and 6 show E5CC-TQX3A5M-003; the recent two-channel operator documentation has used -000 for both. -003 is a real distinct Omron variant with RS-485 / HB features. Record the actual fitted CH2 type before finalising terminal diagrams.HIGH
Restart inhibition is still unprovenSheets 3–4 and 11 propose Finder 13.61 impulse control and an OFF-after-supply-return state. Verify 13.61 mode and power-loss/recovery behaviour, including held button and short interruption. A programme power-on RESET does not independently break the DC heater supply.HIGH
Check socket suffix and 15 A dutySheets 3–4 and 7–8 use Finder 62.31.9.024.4800 on an unverified 92.03-family socket; confirm A1/A2/34/14 actual terminal mapping and rated continuous current under enclosure temperature.HIGH
Validate selected yellow ACTIVE lamp and 24 V SSR inputHL1/HL2 now specified as RS PRO 130-1086, 24 V DC, 20 mA max, 14 mm cutout, yellow. Crydom input 15 mA max gives 35 mA combined per channel, versus W1/W2 DC1 output max 100 mA. Verify actual fitted lamp, wiring polarity and operation; not a heater-current sensor.MEDIUM
DC breaker/source/thermal coordinationSheets 7–8 show 0–60 V / 15 A per channel, 16 A Lovato breaker, Finder DC relay and Crydom DR2220D30U. Verify available fault current, trip selection, conductor and connector rating, SSR dissipated heat and DC load limits.HIGH
Fix actual terminal and connector namingThe D12 uses JP1-IN/OUT and JP2-IN/OUT for channels 1/2; the interactive operator panel assigns separate JP1/JP2 on CH1 and JP3/JP4 on CH2. These are naming differences; produce one physical identifier list before wiring. X1–X4 net IDs are logical, not ordered hardware terminals.MEDIUM
Validate all protection pathsDD11 inlet fusing/selection, enclosure and door PE continuity, DC supply disconnect/E-stop strategy, sensor-fault MV, SSR-off/reset behaviour and 24 V protective circuits remain for commissioning.HIGH
No proof of heater current from an indicatorACTIVE is an intended control-demand status; rising SV, OUT1 and the amber lamp (if lit) are not measurements of externally delivered DC current. USB-only Omron trials validate programming logic, not heater outputs.MEDIUM

Manufacturer references: Finder series 13 / 62 / 92; Omron E5CC-T -000 versus -003 product data; Weidmüller 8950770000; Crydom DR2220D30U DC SSR. Real control assembly has not been energised for validation.
